raw_segments.text: Kent, let it fall rather though the fork invade the region of my heart, be Kent unmannerly
What wouldst thou do, old man?
Thinkst thee thou that duty shall have dread to speak when power to flattery bows, to plainness
honours bound when majesty falls to folly.
Reverse thy state, and in thy best consideration check this hideous rashness.
Answer my life my judgment, thy youngest daughter does not love thee least, nor are those empty-hearted,
whose low sounds reverb no hollowness.
